title: ZoomInfo Named a Flagship Data Partner for Hunter, Salesforce's New Outbound Sales Agent
key_facts: ZoomInfo (Nasdaq: GTM) confirmed on 15 Oct 2026 it is a flagship data partner for Salesforce's Hunter.
Hunter is Salesforce's new outbound sales agent for Sales Cloud; it learns a team's sales motion from calls, emails and notes.
It works within existing permissions and asks the rep for approval on judgment calls.
ZoomInfo data covers more than 100 million companies and 500 million contacts.
Hunter can spot a funding round or new hire at a target account and draft outreach for review.
Access is built in, no separate login or contract (Rohan Punamia, vice president of product management at Salesforce).
Dennis Sevilla, chief strategy officer at ZoomInfo, is quoted.
quote_evidence: ZoomInfo (NASDAQ: GTM), the all-in-one AI GTM platform, has confirmed it is one of the flagship data partners for Hunter, Salesforce's new outbound sales agent built for Sales Cloud.
No separate contracts are needed, ZoomInfo ships with Hunter out-of-the-box.
why_it_matters_hint: AI sales agents depend on outside data, and partnerships decide who supplies it.
